narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Informational advice -> Common bride requests -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional and educational piece for a dermatology clinic, specifically targeting brides-to-be. The doctor explains that complex skin treatments like collagen stimulation require at least a three-month lead time before a wedding. She then outlines the most frequent requests from clients—achieving clean skin, defined facial features, and a glowing complexion—positioning the clinic as the expert solution for bridal beauty preparation.
